'''Werewolf''' is a race in Vampire Life that you become through infection. The steps below follow the video guide "How To BE WEREWOLF in Vampire Life!" by ItzVexo (Oct 18, 2026).

== How to Become a Werewolf ==
* If your character is currently a vampire or another race, return to human form first. Travel to the first village and buy a human dose potion from a merchant NPC there.
* Find a werewolf player or a werewolf NPC at level 6,000 or higher and get scratched by them. Each scratch has a 5% chance of infecting you — keep trying until the infection succeeds.
* Once infected, wait for the full moon. When it rises, you will turn into a werewolf immediately.
* As a werewolf, manage your hunger by eating the bodies of dead characters lying on the ground and using the devour action.

== Werewolf Ring ==
The '''Werewolf Ring''' is a permanent item that lets you stay in full wolf mode. It is available at the Hunter Shop for 400,000 in-game money.

== October 15, 2026 Update ==
From the game's October 15, 2026 update announcement:
* The strongest werewolf on the server receives an '''Alpha''' tag with a 20% buff.
* Over 20 new werewolf skins were added.
* Any attack by a werewolf poisons vampires.
* The werewolf's Howl ability summons other werewolves.
* Werewolves cannot bite Originals.
* Werewolf ability cooldowns were reduced, and fatal attacks were added.
* The update also added new animations for giving and drinking blood, smoother attack animations, and minor gore on bodies, plus several bug fixes.
